_readme: Copy to config.json in the bot folder (DEGEN_HOME). Only user-specific settings live here; trading rules live in cost-basis.json (seed: seeds/cost-basis.seed.json). Secrets go in .env, never here.
_run_side_help: box = Phase 1 (hosted on the Grok Bot box, 5-min checks). pc = Phase 2 (owner's Windows PC, 1-min checks). Only the matching side may run or send; the other side refuses.
_seed_mode_help: deposit = seed starting prices from live quotes when the first deposit lands; test-trade = one approved small real swap; manual = owner-entered prices.

features._help: Asked once at setup (one multi-select). savings_mode: each time the wallet gains $10, buy $4 of JitoSOL (staked SOL) and keep it out of trading. memecoin_mode: each $10 gain buys $1 of Greedy Goats (memecoin), held for fun. interest_mode: half the USDC earns Jupiter Lend interest and half the trading SOL is held as JitoSOL for staking rewards; pulled back automatically when a trade needs it. Apply with apply_features.py.

_engine_readme: engine_url = where TRADING TEMPLATE ENGINE.txt is published; engine_manifest_url = engine-version.json next to it (leave as-is to derive it from engine_url). Used by update_engine.py and the weekly update check.
